# Andrew Gelman Statistical Lexicon Explorer {.home-title .unnumbered .unlisted}

[Every entry in the lexicon, explained, with a simulation you can play with.]{.home-lead}

Since 2009, Andrew Gelman has kept a running [Handy Statistical Lexicon](https://statmodeling.stat.columbia.edu/2009/05/24/handy_statistic/) on his blog: short, funny names for *"important methods and concepts related to statistics that are not as well known as they should be."* This site gives each of the **155 entries** on the list (as of November 2026) its own page, with an explanation and an interactive simulation that runs in your browser.

[I love Gelman's lexicon page and have learned a lot from reading it through the years. With the help of coding agents, I built this homage to the author and to the lexicon itself. Enjoy it.]{.home-note}

[Start here](start-here.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg .me-2} [Random entry](random.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-lg .me-2} [About this site](about.qmd){.btn .btn-link}

[Version 0.10, 13 November 2026.]{.site-version}

```{=html}
<section class="home-today" id="entry-of-the-day" aria-labelledby="today-label" hidden>
  <div class="today-label" id="today-label"><i class="bi bi-calendar-heart" aria-hidden="true"></i> Entry of the day</div>
  <div class="today-body">
    <span class="today-num"></span>

<script>
// Entry of the day: the same entry for everyone on a given (UTC) day, read
// from the table of every entry further down this page. Stays hidden without
// JavaScript.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#listing-entries tbody tr"));
  if (!rows.length) return;
  var num = function (r) { return Number((r.querySelector(".listing-order") || {}).textContent) || 0; };
  rows.sort(function (a, b) { return num(a) - num(b); });
  var row = rows[Math.floor(Date.now() / 86400000) % rows.length];
  var link = row.querySelector("a.listing-title");
  var box = document.getElementById("entry-of-the-day");
  if (!link || !box) return;
  box.querySelector(".today-num").textContent = "#" + num(row);
  box.querySelector(".today-title").textContent = link.textContent;
  box.querySelector(".today-title").href = link.getAttribute("href");
  box.querySelector(".today-go").href = link.getAttribute("href");
  box.querySelector(".today-def").textContent = (row.querySelector(".listing-description") || {}).textContent || "";
  // Theme, kind and level, separated by commas; one theme name has a comma of its own.
  var tags = ((row.querySelector(".listing-categories") || {}).textContent || "").trim()
    .replace("Causes, samples and populations", "Causes samples and populations");
  box.querySelector(".today-tags").textContent = tags.split(",").map(function (s) { return s.trim().replace("Causes samples", "Causes, samples"); }).join(" · ");
  box.hidden = false;
});
</script>
```
